predecessor_disposition.reason: The deterministic V1 engine was dry-run during harness development. Its outcomes cannot be reused as protected evidence. No V1 GREEN/RED is promoted to K4 evidence.

protected_engine.rule: Within each already-frozen semantic obligation class, quantitative nuisance/phase coordinates are generated from the protected seed. The prediction vector is not used in ranking.

public_beacon_rule.network: League of Entropy drand quicknet mainnet
public_beacon_rule.selection: Use the first quicknet round whose canonical round timestamp is at least 900 seconds after the GitHub committed_at timestamp of THIS successor-freeze commit. The successor-freeze commit must exist before the selected round exists.
public_beacon_rule.verification: Record round, signature/randomness payload returned by the public relay, retrieval timestamp and source URL in GMI_K4_PUBLIC_BEACON_V2.json. Prefer a drand client/signature verification when available; lack of cryptographic verification must be explicitly reported, not silently assumed.
public_beacon_rule.no_reroll: Exactly one selected round. A failed or inconvenient result never authorizes selecting another beacon round.

protected_execution_rule: No gmi_k4_search_v2 protected cell may run until GMI_K4_PUBLIC_BEACON_V2.json exists and satisfies the committed rule. Development probes may use a fixed non-beacon seed but must label themselves DEVELOPMENT_ONLY and may not enter the protected aggregate.
verdict_rule: Same as the inherited K4 freeze: K4_RECOVERY_GREEN, THEORY_RED, INCONCLUSIVE_GRAMMAR, INCONCLUSIVE_SEARCH. Every positive cell retains the negative-twin requirement.

independence_residue.IG-3_leakage: CLOSED_TO_COMMIT_ORDER_SCOPE_BY_GITHUB_ANCESTRY; private precomputation remains a governance caveat

claim_ceiling: A V2 protected result can close same-author, future-seeded K4 cells at this finite mechanism scope. It cannot self-certify independent primitive selection, independent cost bucketing, K5 held-family prediction, or historical architecture uniqueness.
